name: Clean Air Task Force (Founders Pledge, 2018)
summary: Policy advocacy and research on US power-plant and methane regulation and carbon capture. A re-implementation of Founders Pledge's 2018 estimate of what CATF's past work cost per tonne of CO₂e averted. It is more than ten times its peers because Founders Pledge counts some 26,000 US coal-plant air-pollution deaths averted by the rules CATF helped win (about $5,650 a death), on top of its tonnes; the tonnes alone give about a fortieth of the result (0.1).

From cost per tonne to tonnes per dollar
sections.explainer: charityevals' step after Founders Pledge's bottom line: Founders Pledge reports dollars per tonne; the site needs tonnes per dollar, and how much air pollution those tonnes cut. Only the coal retirements burn less fuel (the methane rules stop leaks; carbon capture works at plants that keep running), and US coal plants replaced by gas cut much less smoke per tonne than the world average (docs/normalization.md 2.5). The tonnes come years after the money is spent, so they are discounted for that wait at the site's discount rate.

Years from the grant until the tonnes are avoided
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge counts CATF's spending from 1996 to 2017 (about 2007 on average) against tonnes avoided by the coal retirements of 2010–15 (13% of the tonnes), the 2012 methane rule (2012–17, 26%), the 2016 methane rule (2016–25, 24%) and the carbon capture tax credit (2020–25, 37%): on average about 2019, twelve years after the average dollar. Low 8: the spending behind these case studies came mostly in the later years; high 16: the carbon capture tonnes come later than Founders Pledge's 2020–25 window. Our judgment from Founders Pledge's dates. Founders Pledge counts a tonne the same whenever it is avoided; the site discounts every future benefit at the discount rate under Your values, in both views (an evaluator stating dollars per tonne takes no view on discounting). The heat deaths a tonne avoids are discounted again from the year it is avoided, in the site's climate conversion.

rows.label: A marginal dollar's tonnes as a share of the past average (our judgment)
rows.explainer: Our judgment, one figure for every model built on an organisation's past average (facts: meta.marginal_vs_past_average, shared with The Life You Can Save's leverage ratio): the cost per tonne is CATF's 1996–2017 budget over the wins it brought forward, an average; the next dollar does less than the average dollar did, since an organisation pursues its best opportunities first. 50%, from 18% to 100% (average = marginal). The evaluator view keeps 100%.

rows.label: Tonnes of CO₂e averted per dollar
rows.explainer: One over Founders Pledge's cost per tonne, discounted for the wait until the tonnes are avoided, like every future benefit on the site. How much air pollution these tonnes cut is the rows below. A marginal dollar is counted at the shared share of the past average (row above).

rows.label: Air pollution these tonnes cut, relative to an average fossil-fuel tonne
rows.explainer: The row the site's climate conversion reads (docs/normalization.md 2.5) for the air pollution each tonne carries. 0 here, our judgment: the only tonnes that burn less fuel are the coal retirements (about 13% of the tonnes), and the smoke they cut is already in Founders Pledge's own count of US coal-plant deaths averted, which the next row adds directly. Counting both would count the same smoke twice (it used to be 13% × 0.13 = 0.017 of an average fossil tonne).

rows.label: US air-pollution deaths averted per year a rule is brought forward (scaled to all of CATF's impact)
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's deaths before they are multiplied by the years each rule was brought forward: the SO₂/NOx rules' yearly deaths (after its gas-price adjustment) and the mercury rule's, scaled up like everything else by the share of CATF's impact the case studies cover.

rows.label: Tonnes of CO₂e averted per year a policy is brought forward (scaled to all of CATF's impact)
rows.formula: (annual_coal_generation_twh * (coal_emissions_factor - gas_emissions_factor) * 1000000 + nsps_2012_annual * nsps_2012_implementation + nsps_2016_annual * nsps_2016_effectiveness + ccs_annual) / case_study_share
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge's tonnes before they are multiplied by the years each policy was brought forward: coal retirements net of gas, the two methane rules and the carbon capture credit, scaled up the same way.

rows.label: US air-pollution deaths averted per tonne (Founders Pledge's own count)
rows.explainer: Founders Pledge counts about 26,000 US deaths from coal-plant fine particles, sulphur dioxide and mercury averted by the rules CATF brought forward (rows above), next to its 117 million tonnes. The site's conversion values each of these deaths like every air-pollution death (by the ages air pollution kills at, times the value-of-life slider) and adds them to the tonnes' own deaths, so the model carries both outcomes FP counted (docs/normalization.md 2.5). Taken per year brought forward (rows above): every policy now counts the same shared number of years ("Years a won reform counts"), so the ratio doesn't depend on it, and the conversion reads no shared value. The evaluator view keeps Founders Pledge's own ratio (26,006 deaths over 116.7 million tonnes), its policies' years differing. Per tonne, so they share the tonnes' wait and credit steps. They don't scale with "Deaths caused by one more tonne of CO₂": they are counted deaths, not a rate per tonne.

rows.explainer: Researchers, lawyers and advocates could typically earn considerably more in consulting, law firms or industry. Our judgment.

rows.label: Salary forgone by staff per dollar of cost (in-kind donation)
Share of the full cost paid in cash
rows.explainer: With credit by share of resources, staff's forgone pay counts as part of the cost, and staff get their share of the outcome. Off, this is 100%.

rows.label: Tonnes of CO₂e averted per dollar donated
rows.explainer: The tonnes per dollar above; with credit by share of resources, times the share of the full cost paid in cash (staff's forgone pay is the rest). The site turns these tonnes into years of healthy life through the deaths they avoid: "Deaths caused by one more tonne of CO₂", its heat part discounted over "Years until the heat deaths from a tonne of CO₂" for every tonne, and its air-pollution part, at once, times "Air pollution these tonnes cut, relative to an average fossil-fuel tonne" above.
